tolerance_rationale: Bhava drishti bala sums signed graha/raasi-drishti contributions over arcsec-level planet longitudes that differ between Python's JPL ephemeris and the TS Moshier/WASM ephemeris. After fixing the structural bug (raasi-drishti houses were never populated), the only residual is <=0.01 sub-unit rounding drift; structural divergences here were >>1 unit.
